description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

 Nightwing ensures our customers succeed when addressing the world’s biggest threats. Nightwing is looking for a Power Infrastructure Engineer to provide subject matter expertise and engineering support to a US Government program near the McLean area. This person will join a multidisciplinary team composed of chemists, material scientists, mechanical/electrical engineers, aerospace, and cyber engineers. The work environment is a very collegial atmosphere with ever-changing technical challenges that elicits excitement and challenge with each new day.
 
The Power Infrastructure Engineer will serve as a member of a team responsible for monitoring and facilitating technical development and production projects being performed for a government customer. Job duties include ensuring that system requirements and specifications are consistent with operational deployment environments, recommending innovative solutions for technical and operational problems, monitoring and documenting component and system tests, ensuring compliance with Government program management practices, supporting program control gates and engineering review boards, and authoring and reviewing project documentation.
 
The Power Infrastructure Engineer will serve as a technical subject matter expert for a variety of power infrastructure system projects. Experience and support in the following areas is a necessity:

Roles and responsibilities center around quickly responding to client knowledge gaps by educating oneself followed by training/briefing the government task managers, as well as internal customer departments, on the relevant technologies. The ultimate goal in the power infrastructure area is to help external contractors identify technical approaches and develop, test, and build capabilities to counter technical advances being made by foreign entities.
 
 Duties will include, but are not limited to: 
 Provide technical expertise on electronic equipment and components
 Communicate complex technical topics effectively to an audience with a broad set of backgrounds
 Evaluate trends in aerospace industry and supporting microelectronic industry to propose strategic technology developments
 Provide customer training and technology transfer
 Review and evaluate relevant information and intelligence provided by client to identify technical vulnerabilities in power and control systems, specifically focused on sub-systems or its components
 Collaborate with internal customers on defining research requirements and strategic mission objectives
 Identify/Eliminate system vulnerabilities
 Review external contractor/vendor technical proposals, experimental results, deliverables, and final reports
 Support customer test activities
 Review contractor test bed facility documentation and experimental test plans
 Prepare, and often deliver, briefing materials to mid-level and senior client management
 Perform troubleshooting
 Review technical specifications
 Conduct tests, perform quality assurance inspections, and assess test data
 Support Customer Review Board
 Anomaly resolution
 Background in critical infrastructure, power systems, and technical security measures 
 Robust experience conducting technical hardware evaluations, reverse engineering systems to identify its function with limited documentation and assessing vulnerabilities 
 Experience working with DOE laboratories 
 Experience briefing technical information to a non-technical audience and producing clear documentation of their technical analysis 
 CONUS travel to government contractor facilities (one week per month)
 OCONUS travel (average 1-2x per year)
 Support installation and deployment opportunities
 
 Required Skills: 
 Minimum 5 years of related experience and Bachelor’s degree (preferably Electrical Engineering, Physics)
 5+ years of experience in electrical component design and/or system operations; hands-on field experience is highly desired.
 Knowledge of system test and validation processes
 Ability to reverse engineer
 Experience with root cause analysis and troubleshooting
 Experience with vulnerability assessment and risk management
 Excellent communication skills
 Team-oriented
 Willingness to become acquainted with new technology
 Configuration management experience
 Must have TS/SCI security clearance with Poly on day one and be eligible for crossover.
 
 Desired Skills: 
 Master's Degree
 Experience with project portfolio management to help balance strategic and quick reaction capabilities within budget constraints and windows of opportunity
 Ability to work under tight deadlines
 Understanding the global procurement supply chain of electrical components, equipment, and instrumentation
 Ability to predict system-level performance implications of minor technical modifications
 Flexibility to adjust technical direction as intelligence picture changes, or becomes more defined
 Help define initial scope and assess technical feasibility of proposed development efforts
 
 Must have TS/SCI security clearance with Poly on day one and be eligible for crossover. 

This requisition is eligible for an employee referral award. ALL eligibility requirements must be met to receive the referral award.

 About Nightwing: 
 
Previously part of a leading Fortune 100 company and headquartered in Dulles, VA; Nightwing became independent in 2024 but continues to support the nation’s most mission impactful initiatives.
When we formed Nightwing, we brought a deep set of credentials and an unfaltering commitment to the mission. For over four decades, our team has been providing some of the world’s most technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence support services to the U.S. government on its most important missions.
At Nightwing, we value collaboration and teamwork. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside talented individuals who are passionate about what they do. Together, we’ll leverage our collective expertise to drive innovation, solve complex problems, and deliver exceptional results for our clients.
Thank you for considering joining us as we embark on this new journey and shape the future of cybersecurity and intelligence together as part of the Nightwing team.
 
 Salary & Benefits
 
The salary associated with this position ($122,000-$253,000) is commensurate with the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, and demonstrated level of expertise. Compensation will be determined based on these factors to ensure alignment with skills, responsibilities, and market standards. 
Nightwing offers medical, vision and dental insurance coverage in addition to a 401k plan, PTO, Holidays, and additional insurances.
 
 
Nightwing is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.
